subject: general
question:
**Change the following from active to passive:**

Historians may well reinterpret the artifact after new evidence emerges.

options.text: The artifact may well be reinterpreted by historians after new evidence emerges.
The artifact may have been reinterpreted by historians after new evidence emerges.
The artifact will be reinterpreted well by historians after new evidence emerges.
The artifact could well be reinterpreting by historians after new evidence emerges.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Historians may well reinterpret the artifact after new evidence emerges."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the artifact" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "may well reinterpret" to "may well be reinterpreted" (modal verb passive structure).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "historians."
 
• Ensure the phrase "after new evidence emerges" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"The artifact may well be reinterpreted by historians after new evidence emerges."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"The artifact may have been reinterpreted by historians after new evidence emerges." – Incorrect tense (past perfect passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"The artifact will be reinterpreted well by historians after new evidence emerges." – Incorrect adverb placement and verb structure.
 
• **Option 4: **"The artifact could well be reinterpreting by historians after new evidence emerges." – Incorrect verb form.
